newsitem.title: UK: Japanese Stocks in London slightly firmer.
newsitem.headline: Japanese Stocks in London slightly firmer.

text.p: Japanese shares in London firmed slightly on Wednesday in mixed trading with some selling in blue chips and traders expected the market to remain quiet ahead of Friday's futures expiry.
Earlier the Nikkei 225 average index in Tokyo shed 242.62 points or 1.18 percent to end at 20,289.93 points, mainly on worries that the yen may continue its rally against the US dollar.
The Nikkei/ISE 50 index was up 2.38 points or 0.15 percent to 1,584.78 points.
"Selling in exporters continued, elsewhere it has been quiet", one trader said.
Among the blue chips Sony which dropped 102 yen to 9,865 yen, and Kyocera, down 155 yen to 8,915 yen, were the most actively traded shares. TDK was marked down 100 yen to 8,400 yen.
